|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Dantooine sites are immune to No Escape. Your Force generation is +1 at each Dantooine site. Once during your control phase, may use 1 Force to ▲ a squadron. While you control a Dantooine site, your squadrons may deploy (deploy cost = squadron's power - 3). (Immune to Point Man.) [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[They're On Dantooine (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Dantooine sites are immune to No Escape. At Dantooine sites, your Force generation is +1. While you control a Dantooine site, your squadrons may deploy without replacement for X Force, where X = squadron’s power -3. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Your” → “At Dantooine sites, your”; “+1 at each Dantooine site. Once during your control phase, may use 1 Force to ▲ a squadron.” → “+1.”; “(deploy cost” → “without replacement for X Force, where X”; “squadron's” → “squadron’s”; “- 3).” → “-3. May not be canceled.”; “Point Man.) [Immune to Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 20. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[They're On Dantooine]].
* Later text: [[They're On Dantooine (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
